D.Diver

Author: MORI Kōji
Artist: MORI Kōji
Synopsis: Kagura Wataru is a young student in law school who lost his parents as a child when someone set fire to their house. Ever since, he's had strange dreams where he visits mundane, familiar settings and people that seem to blend into reality, interspersed with visions where his body is enveloped in fire. As he progresses in his studies of criminal law, his increasing contact with evildoers triggers something inside him…
